text: ◊ Benzethonium chloride, which produced mild skin irritation at a concentration of 5% but not lower, was not considered to be a sensitiser, and was considered to be safe at a concentration of 0.5% in cosmetics applied to the skin and at a maximum concen- tration of 0.02% in cosmetics used in the eye area.1 1.
